name: barbarian class
mana cost: {R}
types: enchantment class
level[1]: if you would roll one or more dice, instead roll that many dice plus one and ignore the lowest roll.
level[2]: {1}{R}: whenever you roll one or more dice, target creature you control gets +2/+0 and gains menace until end of turn.
level[3]: {2}{R}: creatures you control have haste.
